Ciluku(mathana)dvādaśīvrata
a.. on the worship of Viṣṇu in Kārttika. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 27 (3 mss.). See below Mathanadvādaśīvrata. C.. compilation by C. Laksminrsimha Sastrin in Telugu script, Masulipatam, 1924. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 657.

Cilukudvādaśīvratakalpa
on ceremony relating to Viṣṇu in Āśvayuja month, observed by women. Taylor II. 179. 180 (with udyāpana an. pūjā).

Cillaravādāḥ
(minor vādas) ny. by Appā Śāstrin. Burnell 120a. Same a. Savyabhicāralakṣaṇavāda, TD. 6638. 6639.
